scope: G3 functional branch only: test-only bounded C owner migration windows dispatched by the closed direct worker publisher over a real bootstrapped C cut and a real side-by-side v2 object store, with a cold verifier for each selected window; no production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch

implementation: A test-only OwnerMigration source purpose and C operation class carry the owner binding, request and source digests, the selected window node and the original audit, which must be the exact original owner effect

One original worker effect selects one bounded window of at most 16 outcomes and 32 retained blobs, never zero of both; its request commits to the owner binding, the reviewed legacy owner, the hash of the exact C-selected prefix it continues and the window bound, and its attribution must be the custody usage for that review

A window starts only from the actual C-selected V1 owner leaf; a restore-reserved or unavailable owner and an already selected V2 owner are refused, and a later window resolves its node, review and unfinished prefix from C records that must match that V1 state

The content-store window is prepared and independently replayed through a C adapter that re-proves the selected NV cut and the live original before and after each boundary call; the v2 store is walked again to match the prefix's physical accounting, and every v2 object, C page and record is allocated, synchronized and read back before the sole NV dispatch through the shared storage publisher

An unfinished window keeps the V1 leaf and records only the selected window node as migration-prefix data; only the complete window replaces it with a V2 leaf binding the exact head record and physical accounting
The store-side prefix or owner head is acknowledged only after a fresh C read of the selected cut shows exactly that window

The direct reader routes a selected owner migration window to a new cold verifier: the previous cut must be a bootstrap, V1 or migration cut bound by frame hash and NV chain; the node, review and window records are re-read and the attribution and request rechecked; the owner point is re-derived from the previous cut alone and the exact leaf edit, roots, deterministic layout and physical closure are rebuilt; nothing dispatches or allocates

The cold V1 verifier accepts a previous migration cut, while the shared V1 replay still refuses an owner with a selected migration prefix or a V2 owner; production builds do not compile the new variants and no production check changes

warning_denied_test_build.note: Up to date in 1.43 s: the same commit's warning-denied test binary was compiled by the migration_tests run in the same target directory

test_behaviour: Each window is one NV dispatch for an original worker effect whose request the test computes independently from the documented tuple; a cold reopen after every window replays it through the cold migration verifier before a fresh C acknowledgement of its prefix or final owner head
At least two windows run, so a C-selected unfinished prefix is continued; the selected V2 head then reads back the exact retained bytes through the test's own independent authority
A further migration of the selected V2 owner is refused with no NV dispatch
A Publish purpose, a substituted request, an anonymous or stale original, a revoked original and a wider window than the original request are each refused before NV
Old, lost and third-party NV replies after the sole dispatch leave the window and the cold reopen failing, with no redispatch and no adoption
slice4_regression.dispatched: test builds only; no production caller

not_claimed: A C reservation of the fresh v2 namespace or joined protected C counters; the fresh-namespace and allocation joins are actual store inventory walks
Cold re-verification of object-store bytes; the cold verifier replays the C records and roots only
A production migration grant shape, a production caller, an installed run or native C activation
A tested V1 publication over a selected migration prefix; the shared replay refuses it but no test exercises that path
Cold lineage verifiers for the index preparation and index job reservation event classes; a migration window over either is refused
Reconciliation of an unselected pending worker attempt after a lost NV reply
Delta overlay, snapshot backup delivery or a V2 owner creation route
Artifact CLI harness passage, installed PAM, physical TPM, loaded LSM or Hyper-V qualification
Any produced image or GWIN0 package; G3 and GWIN0 remain open
